en.headline: 13th Hong Kong Food Carnival opens Saturday with 330 stalls
en.dek: The nine-day event at Kwai Chung Sports Ground runs from 24 October to 1 November, adding a Southeast Asian zone and Beyblade battles alongside $6 entry and evening free admission.
body: The Chinese Manufacturers’ Association of Hong Kong will stage the 13th Hong Kong Food Carnival from 24 October to 1 November at Kwai Chung Sports Ground, with more than 330 outdoor stalls across seven themed zones.

Organisers said the grounds would open daily from 11 am to 9 pm, with last entry at 8:30 pm (8 pm on the final day). Entry is HK$6, free from 7 pm, and free for children under one metre, seniors aged 65 or above and persons with disabilities. Payment is by Octopus, AlipayHK, Alipay or WeChat Pay only.

A new Southeast Asian food zone joins the existing hot-food areas. Highlights include limited $1 and 10-percent-off deals on opening and closing days, $10 and $30 mixed-purchase zones, and free wine samples at set times. The first two days will feature Beyblade S1 battles for parent-child and individual categories, with free stadiums provided.
The venue is a short walk from Kwai Fong MTR station exit D. Electronic tickets have been on sale since 9 October through major platforms.

zh.headline: 第13屆香港美食嘉年華星期六葵涌開幕
zh.dek: 一連九日設逾330個攤位，新增東南亞美食區及爆旋陀螺街霸戰，入場費6元，晚上7時起免費。
body: 香港中華廠商聯合會主辦的第13屆香港美食嘉年華將於10月24日至11月1日在葵涌運動場舉行，全場設逾330個戶外攤位，劃分為七大主題區。
大會表示，每日開放時間為上午11時至晚上9時，最後入場為晚上8時30分（最後一日提早至晚上8時）。入場費6元，晚上7時起免費，身高1米或以下小童、65歲或以上長者及殘疾人士免費。只接受八達通、AlipayHK、支付寶及微信支付。
今屆新增東南亞美食區，匯聚多款街頭美食。開幕及閉幕期間推出低至1元或一折限量優惠，並設10元及30元隨心購專區。首兩日舉行爆旋陀螺S1街霸戰，分親子組及個人組，現場免費提供陀螺盤。
場地位於港鐵葵芳站D出口附近，電子門票已於10月9日起透過多個平台發售。
